verses.text: wajjahtu lil laahi hamdan wahwa karramanii
bil mustafaa wa bihi lii jaada bil amani
innar rasuulu lasayfun yustadaa-u bihi
muhannadun min suyuufil laahi zil minani
nahjur rasuulil lazii mamisluhu basharun
nahju bihi fuztu bil mafruudi was sunani
nazaafatus sunnatil baydaa-i kaashifatun
hanii zalaaman wa taabal qalbu kalbadani
kitaabuhu saanani han kulli mafsadatin
wa kaffa hannil azaa kamaa mahaa dadani
lii bana anna kitaabal laahi laysa lahu
mislun wa lii qaada fawqas su-li bir rasani
hilmi wa diinii wa haadatii bihi saluhat
bihi unabbihu ahlal hasri min wasani
lil mustafaa hinda rabbin naasi man tabatun
tahluu maraatiba ahlis siiti wal mikani
al laahu faddalahu qidman wa jallalahu
wa laa yakuunu lahu mislun wa lam yakuuni
khadamtu khayral waraa fil bahri khidmata man
jazaa-u rabbun kariimun fahtalaa bikuni
laqad nazamtu ladaa man sallasuu samadan
min qul huwal laahu maa sharwaahu lam yabini
qaataltu fil bahri shaytaanan wa kabkabahu
khayrul waral mujtabaa fii sahbihit tabani
halayhi min salawaatil laahi at-yabuhaa
fil aali was sahbi man fazuu bilaa darani
zillun nabiyyi rasuulil laahi zallalanii
wa batti hannil lazii qad haaqa kalqarani
yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halaa sanadii
wal aali was sahbi yaa zal amni waz zamani
minnii taqabbal bihi madhii biqadrika yaa
man lii yajuudu bihi bil bishri wal amani
